query: db.readings.aggregate([ { $match: { $expr: { $allElementsTrue: { $map: { input: "$wind_speeds", as: "item", in: { $gt: ["$$item", 70] } } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, station: 1, wind_speeds: 1 } }])

db.readings.aggregate([ { $match: { $expr: { $anyElementTrue: { $map: { input: "$wind_speeds", as: "item", in: { $gt: ["$$item", 50] } } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, station: 1, wind_speeds: 1 } }])
